headline: Draft Smart, Start Stupid
dek: Week 1 gave us a 173-point van, a kicker who scored 1, and a waiver steal that never left the bench.

headline: Quarterbacks Are Decorative, Apparently
dek: Two benched quarterbacks scored 56.96 combined, Josh Allen scored 40 in a loss, and the Van has a head of steam.

headline: Competence Is Not a Rewards Program
dek: Two bench changes would flip a loss by 0.02, the Van becomes Dirtbag Dynasty, and IR Merchant sets another perfect lineup.

headline: The Basement Has Had Enough
dek: The Juniors upset the Professional, Maye answers the complaint department, and Dirtbag Dynasty becomes the last unbeaten team.

headline: You Couldn't Have Won Anyway
dek: Every loser's best lineup still loses, three managers get every decision right, and the quarterback complaints keep aging badly.

headline: Triple Digits Sold Separately
dek: Four teams miss 100 and one of them wins, Dirtbag Dynasty hits 174.1 with a perfect lineup, and arjunpatelmb loses by 5.84 with nobody at kicker.

headline: Neatness Does Not Count
dek: Every winner leaves at least 11 points on the bench, both perfect lineups lose, and D.Achane hang low ends Dirtbag Dynasty's unbeaten run.
